title: Sunset Farm
description:
Peaceful Airstream retreat on a 12 acre property 30 minutes from Nashville. Escape and experience country life with beautiful views and stunning sunsets. Perfect for couples.

The space
There is a queen size bed in the front of the airstream with tons of storage.  There are 2 extra beds that can be convereted from the dining table and sofa seating. Enjoy a kitchen with a refrigerator, oven, stove, and microwave. There is also a full bathroom with a standup shower, toilet and sink.

Other things to note
We have a friendly goldendoodle that will most likely want to come and greet you during your stay.
